about: Demo pack G2 (D52): 5 synthetic recovery messages for the harassment log (forward them to the bot, or POST them to /api/cases/{id}/events). All sent to Raju himself (contacted = borrower), so H3 must come from the words. Rules H1-H6 from the RBI circular on recovery agents (12 Aug 2022); H6 (5+ calls a day) is our threshold and is not in this pack. The only Aadhaar-like number is the synthetic 1234 5678 9012; the evidence PDF must show it as XXXX XXXX 9012. Expected rules were written by hand BEFORE any run.

items.text: Kal tak paisa nahi diya to dekh lena. Teri photo mohalle ke group mein daal denge.
items.why: 2:00 PM is inside 08:00-19:00 (no H1). 'dekh lena' = threat (H2); photo in the neighbourhood group = public shaming (H4).

items.text: Tune EMI nahi bhari, isliye tere bhai aur office wale ko call kar diya.
items.why: Says they called his brother and his office = contacting family and employer (H3, from the words). No threat, daytime.

items.text: Court ka order nikal gaya hai, police aa rahi hai arrest karne. Aadhaar 1234 5678 9012 hamare paas hai.
items.why: False claim of a court order, police and arrest (H5). The PDF must mask the Aadhaar as XXXX XXXX 9012.

items.text: Kamine, paisa abhi wapas kar, warna tujhe chhodenge nahi.
items.why: 11:30 PM is after 19:00 (H1, plain code); abuse + threat (H2).

items.text: Namaste, aapki EMI Rs 1,900 kal due hai. Kripya samay par bhugtan karein.
items.why: A polite reminder at 11:00 AM breaks no rule: the log must not cry wolf.
